title: Implement engineering CLI, persistent session and real shadow run

checks.name: module_help
checks.result: python -m mode_p_vnext --help is a real argparse entrypoint and does not create a session or invoke creative/model code.

checks.name: persistent_state
checks.result: Session state is the authoritative UTF-8 canonical JSON record; explicit transitions append immutable JSONL events, bind current artifact hashes and commit IDs, use R2.1 cross-process locks, atomically replace snapshots, reject corrupt or illegal records, and replay one durable event tail after a crash.

checks.name: isolated_shadow_artifacts
checks.result: Shadow accepts the same UTF-8 script input but writes only under an explicit vNext shadow_runs directory, rejects v4 cache/generation/delivery and external submission, does not import v4, and records unavailable creative comparison fields honestly during R2.2.

checks.name: manifest_written
checks.result: Each Shadow run uses the R2.1 atomic transaction to publish immutable SHADOW_OUTPUT and comparison artifacts, then writes SHADOW_MANIFEST.json with source hash, isolation flags, commit-manifest hash, artifact count, and production_ready=false. The supplemental compatibility, security, pause/resume, and recovery regression set passed 33 tests.
